_note: Per-AHJ threshold profiles. The explicit CLI arguments always override a profile. Values are the published AHJ requirements; add a profile per jurisdiction as engagements need them. Owner rule (2026-11-26): the -95 dBm portable threshold stands in every profile regardless of DAQ wording; SINR rides alongside.

ifc_default.source: generic SBC/ERCES-standard-style defaults; not a jurisdiction

dc_ouc.source: DC OUC v7.1: BDA noise 15 dB below the site noise floor, squelch at the distribution noise +5 dB, near test at -5 dB operating / -10 dB damaging, coverage maps with 10 channels assumed simultaneous

la_county.source: LA County v7-C3-S21: idle-state noise -150 dBm at the donor site, SINR 20 dB on instrumented P25 decode, calculated uplink per grid cell

sf.source: SF ERRCS Technical Requirements v2.0: peak downlink composite +37 dBm, uplink ERP at the donor +24 dBm per channel, squelch fixed at -75 dBm, all filters 75 kHz with 20 us group delay, equal-power derating at full loading

collier.source: Collier County P25 ERCES guidelines: 32 us propagation cap, SINR 18 dB / BER 2.5 percent, no-harm test with the county's managed services provider
